authority_criterion: At least two phases: >=1 cm peak and >=5 mm active RMS executed sample-dependent object translation plus >=0.01 rad arm RMS; every phase >=0.5 mm object RMS and >=0.002 rad arm RMS. This operational criterion is not a calibrated 1–10 authority scale.

42.velocity_limit_contract: The accepted compiled model has no actuator velocity cutoff. Actual per-joint peaks are reported; the refiner bounds added arm velocity to 0.7 rad/s. No velocity limit was introduced or relaxed.

frozen_diffusion.conditioning_contract: Matched native largebox motion prior; identical condition for both seeds. Actual compact initial state, final task goal and contacts are imposed by refinement, not claimed as diffusion outputs.

causal_requirements.criterion: Both sample-vs-baseline and sample-vs-sample must show >=0.5 mm RMS object/root motion OR >=2 mrad RMS native posture in every phase; no success from numerical differences alone.

42.method: Nonlinear arm-only hand-pose IK, frozen-sample object translation and null-space arm posture; additive physics-rate reference and servo feedforward with RNE torque difference; no root/leg/waist/gripper changes.
